name: @taste-and-see/nest-common
description: Shared Nest plumbing for the Taste & See platform. Exports ZodValidationPipe (RFC 7807-shaped Bad Request body on schema parse failure, .strict() rejection of unknown fields per CLAUDE.md §3.3) and RfcProblemFilter (global exception filter converting HttpException + unhandled exceptions into RFC 7807 Problem Details JSON with traceId per CLAUDE.md §5.1). Lifts the verbatim copies that lived in every service's src/common/{pipes,filters}/. TS-080-followup-2.
